title: Leisure Time
objectives: Use verbs of liking + V-ing / to-infinitive
Read a letter for the writer's request
grammar: verbs of liking + V-ing: I love fishing.
prefer + V-ing / to-infinitive: I prefer making boats.

lost_letter.letter:
Dear Mr Tom,

In my leisure time I love fishing by the river and I am keen on making small wooden boats. Last week I lost my favourite fishing net near the old bridge. My grandson prefers doing DIY, so he wants to make me a new one, but I still miss the old net.

Could you ask the villagers to keep an eye out for it?

Best wishes,
Sam
lost_letter.question: What does Sam want Mr Tom to do?
choices: Ask the villagers to look for his net
lost_letter.hint: Tìm câu hỏi nhờ vả ở cuối thư: "Could you ask the villagers to ...?"
